Name: Obelisks to Magical Doors
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
Changes Obelisks (Earth, Water, Desert, Island and Farm) to Magic Doors. Earth/Mountain shows a tree. Water/Breach shows water and fish. Desert shows cactus. Island shows a map of the Island. Farm shows the farmhouse door. Works great with build anything anywhere.

Two new Obelisks added with V1.5.0. Wizard Tower and Walnut Room  Obelisks.

[b]Insulation[/b]
·      Download and Install the Latest Version of SMAPI.﻿﻿
·      Download and Extract Content Patcher mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
·      Download and Extract [b]Obelisks to Magical Doors[/b] into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.﻿﻿﻿
Launch Stardew Valley. 

Enjoy
Spanish translation by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Hayato2236]Hayato2236[/url]
